title: AWS License Manager: tracking software licences

kcs.statement: AWS License Manager tracks and enforces software licences from vendors such as Microsoft, Oracle and SAP, including licences you bring yourself, across AWS and on-premises servers, so usage cannot exceed what was bought.

problem_ideas: A company owns 200 Windows Server licences and runs Windows on EC2 and on-premises: which service stops it exceeding 200?
An auditor from a database vendor asks for proof of licence usage: which AWS service produces it?
A launch is blocked because it would break a licence rule: which service enforced that?
License Manager vs AWS Config for 'track how many Oracle cores are in use across accounts': pick and justify.
What does BYOL mean, and why does it make licence tracking necessary?
Distractor drill: 'manage software licences across AWS and on-premises' with options License Manager, Marketplace, Systems Manager, Artifact.
